scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,mlflow -c cyan,green,magenta "bun --cwd apps/web dev" "MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=http://127.0.0.1:5001 uv run --project apps/api uvicorn repomedic.transport.app:app --reload --port 8000" "uv run --project apps/api mlflow server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5001 --backend-store-uri sqlite:///data/mlflow.db --default-artifact-root ./data/mlartifacts"
scripts.check: biome check . && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.check:fix: biome check --write . && uv run --project apps/api ruff check --fix apps/api && uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd apps/web typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.test: bun --cwd apps/web test && uv run --project apps/api pytest
scripts.contract:generate: uv run --project apps/api python -m repomedic.cli.contract && bunx openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/lib/api/generated.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run contract:check && bun run build
